question: Estimate the SaaS sales opportunity among Indian SMEs.
idealClarificationQuestions: Total addressable revenue for SaaS vendors (any category) from Indian SMEs? Yes.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Frame the approach
expectedLogicalStructure.description: SME count × SaaS spend per SME.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Average annual SaaS spend per paying SME: ~₹4-8 lakh (mix of small ₹50K to large ₹40L).

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: TAM (if all 3.5L digitally-aware SMEs paid): 3.5L × ₹6L = ~₹21,000 Cr.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Plus micro-business + freelancer SaaS (Vyapar, Khatabook, ProfitBooks): ~₹5,000 Cr.

benchmarkAssumptions.parameter: Average annual SaaS spend per paying SME
Current SaaS revenue from Indian SMEs
By 2030 SAM (~70-80% digital + GST/e-invoicing mandates + AI tools)
Plus micro-business + freelancer SaaS (Vyapar, Khatabook, ProfitBooks)

calculationFlow: Currently paying for any SaaS: ~40% = 1.4 lakh.
Average annual SaaS spend per paying SME: ~₹4-8 lakh (mix of small ₹50K to large ₹40L).
Current SaaS revenue from Indian SMEs: 1.4L × ₹6L = ~₹8,400 Cr.
TAM (if all 3.5L digitally-aware SMEs paid): 3.5L × ₹6L = ~₹21,000 Cr.
By 2030 SAM (~70-80% digital + GST/e-invoicing mandates + AI tools): ~₹35,000-40,000 Cr.
Plus micro-business + freelancer SaaS (Vyapar, Khatabook, ProfitBooks): ~₹5,000 Cr.

finalAnswerRange.ideal: Plus micro-business + freelancer SaaS (Vyapar, Khatabook, ProfitBooks): ~₹5,000 Cr.
